policy.ride_exit: Fresh E at any dock or queued while moving; circular service does not auto-eject at an artificial final stop.
policy.passenger_attachment: Game seated ride, original capsule retained and physics suspended; no free walking inside bus
policy.signal_clearance: Red/amber stops before the full bus nose. Moving green nose entry, or amber insufficient2m/s2 braking room, latches source crossing clearance until the rear passes source exit+0.5m; native full-box human/obstacle sweeps remain active.
policy.boarding: Both actual right-side doors; native supported same-side approach, 1.43–3.95m right of bus centre and1.95m either side of each door; head/torso line of sight. Fresh E works while walking or after a menu shortcut; movement is neutralized only after boarding.
policy.boarding_hold: All stops accept fresh E at both real doors and hold while a legal prospective passenger occupies them.
policy.wait_request: At every source-walk stop E toggles waiting; it never instant-spawns or auto-boards a bus.
policy.native_release: Normal E exits hold player movement for two physics ticks, then restore native player/bus collision only after a native full-bus query confirms the outside player RID is no longer overlapping. Validated external teleports restore the caller controls immediately but use the same delayed collision-pair cleanup.

source_binding.graph_basis: Consecutive original OSM shared node IDs, existing source-forward one-way ring; turn curves stay inside existing drive triangle union.

preflight.notes: Source-display estimated widths and authored lanes, not surveyed bus swept-path approval. Native terrain/full-box checks remain mandatory.
